matches.text: - `model.num_refs` is how many reference haplotypes each predict haplotype is scored against, taken nearest-first by TMRCA. It sets the size of the per-interval TMRCA matrix, so it drives extraction time and memory more than anything else here. Setting this to be quite low (less than 10 even) can be useful for little reduction in accuracy depending on the demography.
Training-time leave-nearest-out, extraction takes the top `num_refs + m` references by TMRCA, drops the nearest `m`, and keeps the next `num_refs`. It is never applied at inference or held-out test.
The blank template also uses `num_refs: 15`. Raise it if you want more reference haplotypes per interval.
